answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to stake a bond whose refund depends on a unique physical-layer fingerprint, much as radar echo refracting across a duct reveals true path geometry rather than a spoofed one. Colluding identities that reuse a fingerprint dissolve as mesa under a gale, because the protocol cross-checks every claimed beacon against. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
